description: Detects scaffolder silent defaults in Core 30 page output. Each entry is a value the scaffolder falls back to when a field is missing from the city/service/client JSON — the exact class of defect that D-10/D-11/D-12 represent.

defaults.rationale: D-12: scaffold-core-30-page.py line 213 falls back to '45-minute' / '45-min' when city JSON omits the field. A match here means the value MAY be a silent default — cross-reference with SC-2 to confirm whether the city JSON provides the value explicitly. If explicit, the match is a false positive (the value happens to equal the default). If missing, the match is a real catch.

D-11: scaffold-core-30-page.py line 208 falls back to 'Dominion Energy coordination' when city JSON omits the field. A match here means the value MAY be a silent default — same cross-reference principle as dispatch_time. Single-Dominion cities that provide the value explicitly are false positives.
